# SECURITY SCAN REPORT (generated by `python3 -m cutwitness.security`)

| Scope | Findings |
| --- | ---: |
| Source tree, tests, docs, manifests, wheelhouse metadata (`vendor/*.lock`, `WHEEL_SHA256SUMS`), `qa/` evidence | 0 |
| Engineering simulation run directory (journal, results, witnesses, analysis, Patch-2 evidence files) | 0 |
| Docker definitions (`server/targets/**/Dockerfile`): secrets in ENV/ARG layers | 0 |
| Candidate package (fresh extraction) | re-scanned during fresh-extraction verification |

Rules: Mobility Database token value (from the environment, if set) and token-shaped values (JWT, bearer, refresh-token JSON), AWS/GitHub/Slack
credentials, private keys, registry credentials (`"auths"`), forbidden files (`.env`, SSH keys, `.netrc`, `.pypirc`, `*.pem`/`*.key`, shell
histories, editor backups `*~`/`*.swp`/`*.orig`/`*.bak`, temp files `*.tmp`/`*.tmp.*`), private host paths, raw W1 feed archives.

## Reviewed suppressions (no silent suppression)
| File | Rules suppressed | Justification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cutwitness/security.py` | private_paths, bearer_value, refresh_token_value, registry_auth | the scanner's own pattern definitions |
| `tests/test_security.py` | private_paths, jwt, bearer_value, private_key, refresh_token_value | positive-control fixtures written to a temp dir at test time |
| `cutwitness/w1.py` | bearer_value | builds the `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` header at runtime; contains no token value |

## Reviewed non-secret
`POSTGRES_PASSWORD=cw` in `campaign/FROZEN_CAMPAIGN.yaml`: fixed credential of a loopback-only (127.0.0.1) throwaway test container; not a secret.

## Offline installation
Runtime and QA dependencies install only from `vendor/wheels` with `--no-index --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:`; `run_one_shot.sh` never
contacts a package index. The token is read only from `CUTWITNESS_W1_TOKEN`, is sent only to the token endpoint, and never appears in
manifests, journals, results or exceptions (`tests/test_workloads.py::test_w1_token_only_from_environment_and_never_persisted`).
